description:
£165 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student lettings market this beautiful six-bedroom student house, ideally situated on the popular Devonshire Place in the heart of Jesmond.

Perfect for a group of students looking for spacious accommodation in a prime location, this fantastic property offers six generously sized double bedrooms, spacious communal areas and a wealth of charming period features.

The accommodation briefly comprises a large living room featuring an attractive period fireplace, alongside a generous kitchen with a spacious dining area, providing the perfect space for socialising with housemates. The property also benefits from two bathrooms and six fully furnished double bedrooms.

Situated in the heart of Jesmond, the property is ideally located within easy reach of the popular bars, restaurants and cafés on Osborne Road, as well as a fantastic range of local amenities. Newcastle and Northumbria Universities are also conveniently accessible, with the university area approximately a 20-minute walk away.

Early viewing is highly recommended. Contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team to arrange your viewing.
